description: This file declares the SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore class, which implements persistent storage for network error logging and reporting endpoints using SQLite in the Chromium project. It includes method declarations for loading, adding, updating, and deleting policies and endpoints, as well as flushing data.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore
classes.description: A class implementing persistent storage for network error logging and reporting endpoints using SQLite, with methods for managing policies and endpoints.
